crossRefs.note: He has bent his bow like an enemy. He has stood with his right hand as an adversary. Has killed all that were pleasant…
Yahweh will not pardon him, but then Yahweh’s anger and his jealousy will smoke against that man, and all the curse…
if I have lifted up my hand against the fatherless, because I saw my help in the gate,
I will turn my hand on you, thoroughly purge away your dross, and will take away all your tin.
But they rebelled and grieved his Holy Spirit. Therefore he turned and became their enemy, and he himself fought…

translations.web: Surely he turns his hand against me again and again all day long.
translations.bsb: Indeed, He keeps turning His hand against me all day long.
translations.kjv: Surely against me is he turned; he turneth his hand against me all the day.
translations.asv: Surely against me he turneth his hand again and again all the day.
